name: Good Friday
overview: Good Friday centers on the profound sacrifice of Christ, who was wounded and bruised for our transgressions, bearing the chastisement that brings us peace and healing, as Isaiah 53:5 reveals. Jesus' cry of abandonment on the cross, recorded in Matthew 27:46, underscores the depth of His suffering. Yet, this dark moment is framed by the assurance of God's protection and presence, as the psalmist declares the faithful abide under the shadow of the Almighty (Psalms 91:1) and are kept secure (Psalms 121:3). Ultimately, the promise of resurrection shines forth, with Christ’s time in the heart of the earth foreshadowed in Matthew 12:40 and the call to arise and shine in Isaiah 60:1, affirming the victory and hope found in His sacrifice.
